title: import-payload emits single next_command
summary: Add next_command to import-payload JSON/human report so adopters and agents get one actionable CLI after dry-run/apply (apply same strategy, escape-hatch on conflicts, bootstrap after apply, adopt when noop).
migration_impact: Additive only. Clients reading next_steps continue to work; prefer next_command for agent routing (parity with adopt/self-migrate).
agent_notes: After plate_import_payload / gh plate import-payload --json, execute report.next_command unless human judgment is required (escape-hatch conflicts). Do not invent force apply from next_steps prose.
